name: news-multi-speaker
profile: French TV news package. Six speakers in 114s, four appearing once for under 12s each, across studio, street and field audio. The hardest diarization case in the set.

name: interview-long-form
profile: French political interview, ~12 minutes. Exercises LLM chunking and hierarchical reduce, plus rapid crosstalk between host and guest.

name: single-speaker-clean
profile: One English speaker, clean studio audio. Baseline transcription quality with diarization unambiguous, and the English half of the language-detection check.

name: noisy-background
profile: Two speakers over background noise and music, ~15 minutes. Robustness of STT and diarization, and the longest content in the set.

name: upload-news-two-speaker
profile: A two-speaker French news segment submitted as a multipart upload rather than a URL, so both ingestion routes are covered. Upload titles derive from the filename, since an uploaded file carries no source metadata.

name: failure-silent-audio
profile: Audio containing no speech. Expects 200 with status no_speech, an empty transcript and summary null - the no-fabrication requirement demonstrated on real audio rather than asserted.

name: failure-corrupt-media
profile: A text file carrying a video extension. Expects 422 UNREADABLE_MEDIA, proving validation is by probe rather than by filename.

name: failure-invalid-url
profile: Disallowed scheme. Expects 400 INVALID_URL, rejected before any network call.
